title: QUIC internal congestion-controller selector work item
summary: Add the internal construction-time congestion-controller selector per path, keep NewReno as the default proof home, and allow CUBIC only as a private implementation choice under the existing RFC 9002 and RFC 8085 invariants.
planned_changes:
- Add an internal controller-choice field to each path record and choose the controller at path construction time.
- Keep NewReno as the default path and preserve the current RFC 9002 NewReno proof homes as the baseline behavior.
- Add the private CUBIC path only as an internal implementation choice that still honors the RFC 9002 and RFC 8085 invariants.
- Thread deterministic monotonic time through the path controller so elapsed-time decisions can be replayed in tests.
- Preserve per-path ACK, loss, ECN, persistent-congestion, and PMTU-normalized congestion math.
- Keep the controller choice below the public API boundary and avoid caller-selectable controller options.
verification_plan: Run focused requirement-home tests for REQ-QUIC-CRT-0156 through REQ-QUIC-CRT-0161, then run SpecTrace validation and git diff whitespace checks.
out_of_scope: Changing the existing RFC 9002 NewReno requirement homes
HTTP/3 or adapter-layer congestion policy changes
